name: Smart Diff groups the Files changed tab by role and shows findings inline
description: From PR #482's Files changed tab, confirm all five reviewer-ordered groups render (Core logic, Tests, Wiring, Docs, Boilerplate) — 'Core logic' rendering with no prior click proves Smart order is the default, since the flat (Original-order) view never shows a role-group header. Confirms the seeded CRITICAL finding on src/config.ts:12 shows its 'blocker' label and FindingCard inline in the (open-by-default) Wiring group, that clicking the Boilerplate header reveals package-lock.json, and that Original order renders the flat file list (docs/rate-limiting.md included). Note: agent-browser's `wait --text` only proves presence, not prior absence, so this flow does not assert that package-lock.json/docs/rate-limiting.md were hidden before their respective steps. Exercises DiffTab's order toggle + SmartDiffGroups + the diff-viewer's injected findings (DiffFindingsApi). Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
